agencyDescription:
The Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) was established in 2025 as a statutory board under Singapore's Ministry of Health (MOH) to serve as the central authority for public health policymaking to manage and control the threat of communicable diseases. This is aimed at strengthening Singapore's public health capabilities built during the COVID-19 response to ensure a unified command and coordinated approach across all situations, from routine disease control to future outbreaks.

CDA safeguards the nation from communicable diseases through disease surveillance, outbreak investigations, vaccination programs, public education, and global health collaboration. Beyond domestic activities, the CDA aims to expand Singapore’s global outreach and foster collaboration with international partners.
jobDescription:
As Senior Manager or Manager/Knowledge Management of the Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) under Ministry of Health (MOH), you will be involved in building a strong knowledge culture and overseeing registry operations in CDA, while working with partners to transform knowledge and records management processes and systems in CDA.

The CDA is a government agency established by the Ministry of Health (MOH) to oversee Singapore’s communicable disease preparedness, prevention and control, surveillance, risk assessment and outbreak response. The CDA consolidates and builds on the public health functions under MOH, the National Centre for Infectious Diseases (NCID), and the Health Promotion Board (HPB).

You will work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment that requires managing multiple stakeholders and priorities concurrently to support CDA's operational needs.
jobResponsibilities:
Knowledge Management:

  • Support the development and implementation of KM frameworks and processes for effective knowledge capture, sharing, and retention across the organisation and execute Knowledge Management initiatives that align with organisational strategic objectives

  • Foster a strong knowledge culture across CDA, working with divisional Knowledge Management Champions to improve Knowledge Management and Registry practices, adoption and capabilities

  • Design and maintain knowledge repositories and collaboration platforms to improve information accessibility

  • Support change management efforts by engaging stakeholders and promoting KM culture through awareness activities and communication campaigns

  • Oversee the management and maintenance of CDA's intranet portal, ensuring content is current, relevant, and accessible to staff

  • Drive innovation initiatives, including exploring AI applications and digital solutions to address operational challenges in knowledge and records management

Records Management and Mailroom Management:

  • Oversee CDA's Registry and mailroom operations, including driving continuous improvement of digital solutions to automate processes where possible

  • Implement and maintain frameworks and processes for the retention, preservation, and declassification of CDA records, working closely with NAS on record management requirements

  • Manage the dissemination of circulars and official communications across CDA to ensure timely and accurate information flow, including co-ordinating with CDA divisions to ensure proper circulation of policy updates, announcements, and operational guidance

  • Establish and maintain the Electronic Records Management System (ERMS) and Email Management System (EMS) for CDA, including system configuration, user management, and ensuring compliance with government records management standards

  • Support the annual audit of CDA's compliance with IM4L by the National Archives of Singapore (NAS)
jobRequirements:
JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • At least 2 years of Knowledge Management experience with demonstrated ability to develop Knowledge Management frameworks and processes and implement them across organisations

  • Experience in establishing and implementing Knowledge Management systems (including change management) e.g. electronic records management systems and email management systems, intranet portals, information dissemination systems

  • Strong change management experience with proven ability to foster knowledge cultures and work with Knowledge Champions across divisions, including experience in cross-functional or cross-agency digital transformation initiatives

  • Technology savvy with experience in knowledge repositories, collaboration platforms, and AI-powered KM tools for digital transformation initiatives

  • Familiarity with Government Instruction Manual on Management of Public Records and government records management standards (IM4L compliance)

  • Independent and self-driven with ability to multi-task in fast-paced, dynamic environments and perform under pressure

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills with strong team player abilities to co-create solutions, facilitate awareness campaigns, and work collaboratively across divisions

jobDescription:
The Director, Office of Digitalisation, Data and AI (ODA) is a senior institutional leader responsible for driving the organisation’s Digitalisation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence Strategy and execution. Concurrently serving as the Chief Data Officer (CDO), this role provides strategic leadership in data governance, enterprise data platforms, analytics, AI governance, and digital enablement.

The role oversees the establishment of robust institutional frameworks, platforms, and capabilities that enable trusted data use, responsible AI adoption, and meaningful digital transformation across the organisation. The Director works closely with senior management, government agencies, industry partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with national directives, regulatory requirements, and organisational strategic priorities.

We are seeking a visionary yet hands-on leader with deep expertise in data, analytics, AI, and digital governance, and a strong track record in leading cross-functional teams, enterprise-scale initiatives, and stakeholder engagement in complex environments.
jobResponsibilities:
Institutional Data Governance and Chief Data Officer Responsibilities

Establish and operationalise institution-wide data governance policies, frameworks, and practices in alignment with national requirements and government circulars. Serve as the organisation’s Chief Data Officer, overseeing data management, data quality, metadata, and controlled data access across the institution. Manage and coordinate internal and external data sharing arrangements, including vetting data-related clauses in agreements upon request. Coordinate implementation of national data directives and prepare statutory submissions such as the Annual Data Report.

Enterprise Data Platforms and Strategic Data Projects

Own and oversee enterprise data platforms within the institutional Data Warehouse. Lead and coordinate major enterprise data initiatives such as learner and business data platforms supporting institutional decision-making. Oversee end-to-end project lifecycle activities including architecture design, data ingestion, specification reviews, testing, issue resolution, and vendor management.

Advanced Analytics, Predictive Modelling and AI Enablement

Provide strategic oversight of predictive analytics and modelling initiatives, including learner analytics and AI-enabled insights. Partner with data engineering teams to operationalise models, monitor performance, and define lifecycle management criteria.

The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) is a uniformed organisation under the purview of the Ministry of Home Affairs. The main role of SCDF is to provide fire-fighting, rescue and emergency ambulance services; mitigating hazardous materials incidents, as well as formulate, implement and enforce regulations on fire safety and civil defence shelter matters.

In 1982, the National Civil Defence Plan was launched which spearheaded the emergency preparedness for the nation. With the enactment of the Civil Defence Act in 1986, the SCDF was established as an independent organisation under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). In the same year, the Hotel New World collapse paved the way for joint operations between the SCDF and Singapore Fire Service (SFS). Due to the similarity in roles and functions, the SCDF and SFS were formally integrated on 15 April 1989.

Over the years, the SCDF has improved its life saving operations through innovations and programmes to enhance her fire-fighting, rescue capabilities and public education plans. The Light Fire Attack Vehicle (The Red Rhino) and Tracked Fire-Fighting Vehicle are some of the customized solutions which the force has developed to increase its operational capabilities. The SCDF also actively engages the local community through its wide-ranging public educational programmes and community-based activities to enhance the resilience and emergency preparedness of the civilian population.

Today, the Force is recognised by the population as a professional body of well-trained officers and men geared to respond to all types of life-threatening emergencies round-the-clock. An operationally ready SCDF, working hand-in-hand with a prepared and resilient population, helps to ensure that the nation is capable of handling any untoward eventualities.

The team’s mission is twofold: to minimise compromise of Singpass accounts at the point oflive logins, and to minimise the damage done on compromised accounts through pre-emptive, active monitoring. As a Data Scientist,what this primarily means in practice is that you will be building state-of-the-art solutions (training ML models, feature engineeringetc.) that detect such fraudulent activities.

Here in Singpass, we believe in building full-stack Data Science capabilities that enable Data Scientists to create impactindependently, end-to-end. This means that you will be expected to:

  • Conduct comprehensive data analytics on big, complex datasets

  • Design MLOps architectures and deploy reliable, scalable ML solutions to cloud infrastructure

  • Build Data Engineering flows that unlock the team’s ability to build new features, signals


You are not just here to write code and execute tasks, but also to figure out what we should be experimenting with and how we shouldcontinuously push the needle in our fight against fraud. We are here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

Decision-making

Ownership

Cross-functional

Continuous Learning

  • Working on new ideas often means not fully understanding what you are working on. Taking time to learn new architectures, frameworks, technologies, and even languages is not just encouraged but essential.

Ultimately, core competencies in data analytics, data engineering and data science methodologies are what really matter to us as a team.

Have a demonstrated ability to experiment rapidly and deploy ML solutions end-to-end.

  • Prior work and personal projects count for much more than specific degrees.


Possess a strong desire for continuous learning.

  • We work as a team so you need to be able to not just solve problems, but have other people understand your solutions.

  • Our job is to push for change in government, so we need to challenge the status quo and not wait for instruction.

Focus on product impact and are user-oriented.

  • We never lose sight of who we are working for, and the impact that our work has.

Overall we look for people who have ability, initiative, good communication, and strong values.

agencyDescription:
The Mission of Ministry of Transport is to develop Singapore's land, sea and air transport sectors so as to enhance our economic competitiveness and quality of life in a knowledge-based economy. MOT oversees the development and regulation of the following sectors:

• Civil Aviation and Air Transport
• Maritime and Ports
• Land Transport

Besides providing an efficient and cost-effective transportation in Singapore, it also strives to make Singapore an international civil aviation and maritime centre for the region.

The ministry sets the strategic and policy direction while operations and regulatory works are carried out by the statutory boards under its charge. jobResponsibilities:
About the Role

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Specialist (Penetration Testing) Trainee to join GovTech's Cybersecurity Group as part of our Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) team. This traineeship programme is designed for fresh graduates or early-career professionals who are passionate about cybersecurity and want to develop expertise in penetration testing and adversary simulation. You will be part of a team that helps protect Singapore's government assets from cyberattacks whilst gaining hands-on experience in cutting-edge cybersecurity practices.

As a trainee, you will receive comprehensive training and mentorship whilst contributing to real-world cybersecurity assessments. You will have opportunities to work on diverse projects spanning infrastructure security, web and mobile application testing, cloud security assessments, and adversary simulation exercises. This dynamic environment will help you quickly assimilate knowledge in emerging technologies and cybersecurity trends aligned with Singapore's Smart Nation initiatives.

What You’ll Expect

  • Gain in-depth knowledge of common and advanced tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) used by cyber adversaries

  • Develop hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology stacks including Terraform, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Work with modern security tools, automation frameworks, and penetration testing platforms

  • Interact with international security researchers and ethical hackers through bug bounty programme management

  • Research emerging penetration testing and adversary simulation methodologies

Key Responsibilities:

  • Learn to conduct VAPT across IT systems, networks, web applications, mobile applications, and cloud deployments under supervision

  • Assist in vulnerability triage and analysis of security findings from various sources including bug bounty programmes

  • Support the team in conducting targeted Adversary Simulations (AS) and learning advanced attack techniques

  • Develop documentation skills by producing findings reports, impact analyses, and remediation guidelines

  • Participate in stakeholder presentations and learn to communicate technical findings effectively

  • Build automation tools using Python or C# to streamline security operations and testing processes
jobRequirements:

  • Proficient in at least one programming language (Python, C#, or JavaScript preferred)

  • Comfortable with PowerShell and bash scripting

  • Strong problem-solving skills and analytical mindset

  • Good communication abilities and enthusiasm to learn

  • Curiosity about cybersecurity, ethical hacking, and emerging threats

agencyDescription: The Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) is Singapore's national land use planning authority. URA prepares long term strategic plans, as well as detailed local area plans, for physical development, and then co-ordinates and guides efforts to bring these plans to reality. Prudent land use planning has enabled Singapore to enjoy strong economic growth and social cohesion, and ensures that sufficient land is safeguarded to support continued economic progress and future development.
jobDescription:
The Strategic Communications and Outreach Group (SCOG) at the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) leads URA's storytelling in all formats so as to promote URA's work and key messages as well as influence public perception. We do this by developing content and stories for a variety of URA's partners, stakeholders and general audiences through different channels (e.g. mainstream media, social media, Singapore City Gallery and outreach programmes). Through this, we facilitate URA's public engagement in building awareness and interest among the community about our work as well as policies in shaping our city. The Outreach and Engagement Department in SCOG is seeking suitable candidates to join us as interns. The team conceptualises, organises and manages a range of outreach projects to positively shape public perception of URA and grow support for its work amongst target audiences. One of our key outreach assets is the Singapore City Gallery, which is a highly immersive and interactive gallery that features urban planning challenges and the innovative solutions that tackle them.

This internship will be under SCOG.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be supporting the revamp of the Singapore City Gallery, which involves updating the Gallery with the latest urban plans for Singapore and exploring new ways of presenting content, including the use of immersive environments and Artificial Intelligence to attract a wider local audience, especially youths. You will be part of the research team responsible for gathering primary and secondary research materials such as visuals and articles from within and outside URA, including the National Archives, to support this project. A revamp only takes place once every five to six years, so seize this exciting opportunity to have a hand in shaping the next iteration of the gallery! You will also be involved in the planning and execution of outreach programmes that leverage the Gallery to build appreciation for URA’s plans and challenges amongst the local community, as well as gain experience in gallery operations, as well as volunteer engagement and management. Key responsibilities include: 

• Conducting research to develop new content that appeals to target audiences for the Singapore City Gallery 
• Research coordination and implementation 
• Documenting and archiving exhibition materials 
• Supporting outreach and engagement programmes including volunteer management

Learning Outcomes

You can look forward to gaining: 

• Firsthand experience in exhibit content research and development 
• Exposure to public engagement strategies, including how to reach diverse audiences through various initiatives 
• Insights into gallery operations, volunteer engagement and management 
• Real-world experience in youth and community outreach 
• A deeper understanding of urban planning in Singapore and how to communicate complex ideas in accessible ways to the public

At NYC, as the national agency for youth matters, we believe in a world where young people are respected and heard, able to take action on issues that matter and make a positive difference around them. Together with our partners, we develop future-ready youth and deepen their commitment to Singapore by imbuing in them a heart for service, resilience and an enterprising spirit. Find out more at www.nyc.gov.sg.
jobDescription:
Throughout the year, Youth Corps Singapore and the National Youth Council welcome young talents to our internship programme. We seek individuals who share our commitment to nurturing future-ready youth and strengthening their dedication to Singapore.
 
Our Internship Programme requires a minimum of 12-weeks commitment.
 
We understand that academic schedules and official internship periods of various education institutions can vary. If you're unable to meet the minimum 12 weeks availability, we still warmly welcome your application. We'll carefully consider each case and let you know if we can accommodate your schedule. We look forward to your application.
 
For more information on YCS Internship Programme, please visit https://www.youthcorps.gov.sg/about-us/apply-for-youth-corps-internship
jobRequirements:
Who Should Apply
The YCS Internship Programme is open to Singaporean students studying Business, Humanities, Social Sciences, Communications & New Media, Events Management or other relevant disciplines in polytechnics and recognised universities.
 
You should be in your penultimate year of studies, or at least six months away from graduation at the point of internship.
 
How To Apply
You may refer to the list of available internship roles at https://go.gov.sg/nycinternshipprogramme 
Please submit your application at https://go.gov.sg/nycinternship-interestform
 
We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply early. Shortlisted applicants can expect to be contacted directly by the hiring division within 4 weeks of application date.

agencyDescription:
Workforce Singapore (WSG) is a statutory board under the Ministry of Manpower (MOM). It will oversee the transformation of the local workforce and industry to meet ongoing economic challenges.

WSG will promote the development, competitiveness, inclusiveness, and employability of all levels of the workforce. This will ensure that all sectors of the economy are supported by a strong, inclusive Singaporean core.

While its key focus is to help workers meet their career aspirations and secure quality jobs at different stages of life, WSG will also address the needs of business owners and companies by providing support to enable manpower-lean enterprises to remain competitive. It will help businesses in different economic sectors create quality jobs, develop a manpower pipeline to support industry growth, and match the right people to the right jobs

jobDescription: To provide effective safety oversight on the service providers for aeronautical meteorological service and Communications, Navigation Surveillance (CNS) and Air Traffic Management systems (ATM), contributing towards AAR Division’s objective to provide safety oversight of the provision of air navigation services in Singapore and indirectly to the growth of Singapore as an air hub.

  • To ensure compliance with national legislation and safety standards by the aeronautical meteorological service provider and the provision of CNS through comprehensive regulatory safety oversight programmes including the conduct of safety audits, inspections and investigation.

jobResponsibilities:
We are a team in GovTech that seeks to design and develop software applications that help government agencies to better serve the needs of the people of Singapore. To that end, we employ an agile approach towards development, and work towards adopting the best practices and tools used in the top technology companies and organizations. We are now looking for a top-notch Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead to join us in this mission.

We are not looking for a diva 10x software engineer. A wise developer once tweeted: “How to be a 10x engineer: help ten other engineers be twice as good.” That is the kind of 10x engineer we are looking for – a capability multiplier, someone who will freely share his skills and knowledge to level-up the whole development team. Are you the one?

If so, you will be joining an agile software team, working on developing engaging, user-centric web applications through practices like pair programming and code reviews. You will also have opportunities to explore areas beyond software development, such as devops, cloud infrastructure and security.

As a software engineer, you will:

  • Work in an agile development team to deliver high quality software applications. This will be full stack, from the web frontend to its backend, from feature development to production deployment.
  • Adopt proven software engineering practices like pair programming, code reviews, test-driven development.
  • If you are a more experienced engineer, you will also be expected to lead conversations on solutioning and systems design, establish best practices and mentor other engineers in the team.

agencyDescription: MAS is the central bank of Singapore. Our mission is to promote sustained non-inflationary economic growth, and a sound and progressive financial centre.
jobDescription: This role is within the IT Operations Division, Network Services Management team, where you will play a critical part in maintaining and evolving the network infrastructure that supports MAS's mission-critical operations.
jobResponsibilities:
We are seeking a highly accomplished Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network) to drive the strategic design and evolution of MAS's enterprise network infrastructure. This role focuses on technical architectural leadership, strategic planning, procurement oversight, and technical governance of critical information infrastructure that underpins Singapore's financial sector.

Strategic Technical Architecture & Planning:

  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-wide network infrastructure solutions, including cloud, software-defined networks, observability and network automation to support MAS's critical information infrastructure

  • Develop and maintain network architecture roadmaps aligned with organisational strategies, ensuring resilience and security of critical systems that underpin Singapore's financial sector

  • Define architectural standards, principles, and best practices for network infrastructure across the organisation

  • Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies to enhance network capabilities whilst maintaining the integrity and security of critical information infrastructure

Procurement & Vendor Management:

  • Lead strategic procurement initiatives for network infrastructure solutions, including preparation of comprehensive technical specifications, evaluation of vendor proposals, and contract negotiations

  • Develop and execute procurement strategies that align with MAS's architectural vision and budgetary constraints, ensuring value for money and risk mitigation

  • Establish and manage strategic vendor relationships with cloud and network technology providers, ensuring alignment with technical architectural standards and business requirements

  • Conduct comprehensive technical and commercial evaluations of network solutions, balancing cost-effectiveness with performance and security requirements

  • Oversee vendor performance management and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level agreements

  • Collaborate with procurement teams to establish framework agreements and preferred vendor arrangements for network technologies

  • Lead market research and supplier assessments to identify innovative solutions and emerging vendors in the network infrastructure space

  • Manage procurement governance processes, including tender evaluations, contract reviews, and risk assessments for network technology acquisitions

Technical Leadership & Oversight:

  • Oversee the management and optimisation of network services, ensuring the highest levels of security, performance, and availability for mission-critical operations

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance on complex network solutions including data centre networking, operational observability, security infrastructure, and hybrid cloud connectivity

  • Review and validate technical designs from project teams and vendors, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, observability and security requirements

  • Lead technical assessments and proof-of-concepts for new technologies and solutions

Stakeholder Engagement & Mentorship:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure network infrastructure solutions in hybrid technology operating environment that meet stringent regulatory and operational requirements

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the network services team, fostering innovation and best practices in critical infrastructure management

  • Engage with senior stakeholders to translate technical strategies into business value and risk considerations

  • Work with vendors and technology partners on strategic initiatives and architectural reviews
jobRequirements:
• Minimum 10 years of experience in network architecture and infrastructure design, with at least 5 years in a senior architect or technical leadership capacity

  • Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale network infrastructure in enterprise or financial services environments

  • Experience with critical information infrastructure protection and regulatory compliance requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technology procurement, vendor management, or contract negotiations for network infrastructure solutions, preferably in government or highly regulated environments

  • Wireless Technologies: Proficient in enterprise wireless solutions including Wi-Fi deployment, wireless controller management, and RF planning and optimisation.

  • WAN Connectivity: Extensive experience with WAN technologies including MPLS, SD-WAN solutions, VPN implementations, and hybrid connectivity architectures

  • End User Computing: Strong understanding of endpoint technologies like Network Access Control (NAC), and ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) for device authentication and authorisation.

  • Network Observability & Monitoring: Expertise in network performance monitoring and analytics using SolarWinds suite, Thousand Eyes for end-to-end visibility, and Riverbed for network layer monitoring.

  • Security Policy Automation: Proficient in automated firewall policy management solutions including Fire Flow for streamlined security rule deployment and compliance management

  • Data Centre & SDN: Deep expertise in Cisco ACI fabric architecture (Spine-Leaf, APIC, VXLAN/EVPN), software-defined networking principles, and data centre design

  • Network Security: Strong knowledge of enterprise security architecture including firewalls, network segmentation, and security policy design

  • Routing & Switching: Expert-level knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and their application in enterprise environments

  • Cloud Networking: Minimum 5 years of experience with hybrid cloud networking architectures and integration with on-premises infrastructure

  • Network Automation: Experience with network automation tools and Infrastructure as Code principles using Terraform, Ansible, and related technologies

  • Comprehensive understanding of government procurement frameworks, including GeBIZ processes and compliance requirements

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in total cost of ownership analysis, lifecycle costing, and budget management for network infrastructure

  • Expertise in preparing detailed technical specifications, statement of requirements, and evaluation criteria for network technology procurements

  • Experience in leading cross-functional procurement committees and managing complex tender evaluation processes

  • Knowledge of contract management principles, including service level agreements, performance metrics, and penalty clauses

  • Understanding of intellectual property considerations, licensing models, and technology transfer agreements in network infrastructure procurements

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in mentoring technical teams and making independent architectural decisions in high-stakes environments

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills with proven ability to present technical strategies to senior management and build credibility with executive-level stakeholders

  • Strong negotiation skills and commercial awareness with proven track record in managing complex vendor relationships and procurement processes

  • Strong team player with track record of working both autonomously and collaboratively, building effective relationships with internal teams, vendors, and external partners

  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities in a mission-critical environment

  • Passion for driving transformational change and innovation in network infrastructure whilst maintaining operational excellence

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to assess risk and impact on critical systems

This is a 2-year contract position offering the opportunity to shape the future of mission-critical network infrastructure within Singapore's central banking and financial regulatory environment, with exposure to cutting-edge technologies and strategic procurement initiatives, and high-level stakeholder engagement..

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

jobTitle: Deputy Director, Strategic Communications & Digital and Social Media
agencyDescription:
Info-communications Media Development Authority (www.imda.gov.sg) offers a rewarding career that gives you a front seat in the fast-changing infocomm media sector, where technology and content are shaping the way people view the world more than ever.

We offer a wide range of opportunities, where talented individuals and teams can make a difference. Whether you are developing a telecommunications policy affecting consumers or spearheading a scheme to nurture budding media talents, each member of IMDA contributes towards driving innovation, enhancing productivity for economic growth, and improving the quality of life for all Singaporeans.

As a statutory board in the Ministry of Communications and Information, IMDA promotes and regulates the infocomm and media sectors.
jobDescription:
Ever wonder what it is like to be the storyteller behind Singapore’s digital revolution? At IMDA, you will join fellow Architects of Singapore’s Digital Future (ASDF). We are building something extraordinary, for Singapore and Singaporeans.

Imagine:
a. Ensuring that Singapore remains connected always to the world via our digital routes, not just the traditional air and sea routes
b. Spurring SMEs to use AI practically, cutting costs, transforming business models and delighting customers
c. Working with the industry to keep the online streets of Singapore safe, just like our physical streets
d. Forging with private and people sector partners an inclusive society as Singapore digitalises, where no one, whether young or old, is left behind

As ASDF, these are some of the bold dreams we turn into reality.

At IMDA, public communications work is not only about telling catchy stories or headlines. It’s about empowering many more to better embrace our digital future. Because when technology meets powerful storytelling, that is when real change happens. You too can be an ASDF.

We are looking for that new ASDF, a creative mind who can see beyond the buzzwords, and turn digital transformation from a fancy techie phrase into stories that resonate in void decks and board rooms alike. So, come, join us, and be one of the cool kids doing cool stuff at a cool place we call IMDA and our home.

The Deputy Director will lead the team to develop and implement a strategic approach towards corporate communications for the organisation. This covers:
a. Strategic communication. This includes (i) building and refining the key organisational messages, and (ii) putting them out effectively in public domain to gain mindshare of relevant stakeholders.
b. Digital & Social Media management. Lead and oversee IMDA's digital and social media teams whilst ensuring integrated, cohesive messaging across corporate and digital touchpoints to effectively reach target audiences.
c. Data-driven insights for our public communications work.
d. Media relations. This involves building and maintaining relations with local and foreign media, and engaging both local and international publications.
e. Crisis communication. This involves reviewing the processes and structures, as well as leading public communications if incidents arise.
jobResponsibilities:
Strategic communications

  • Develop, refine and execute the overarching narrative for the key areas of work of IMDA among the target audience groups, and advance IMDA’s core interests through public communications. This involves the following:
  • Plan and pull the key theme messages together into an overarching narrative, and put in place enabling processes and best practices to develop, refine and execute the narratives
  • Build the message house for IMDA and work with the relevant HODs and within CMD team structure to ensure coherence in IMDA’s messaging across multiple audience groups so as to support the overarching narratives
  • Lead and coordinate efforts with other government agencies and ministries as required
  • Deliver the overarching narrative effectively, whether through social media, media coverage or offline presence such as events and interviews.
  • Manage profiling of IMDA through ExCo members in terms of official engagements, via media or events, including presence of IMDA ExCo on social media platforms to ensure consistency of messages across platforms

Digital & Social Media management

  • Lead the Digital & Social media teams who manage IMDA’s owned channels (website & social) to communicate and educate key target audience groups
  • Be able to integrate messaging and approach across ‘Corporate’ and ‘Digital & Social’ media channels so that there is cohesiveness in messaging across all channels and touchpoints
  • Develop and manage social media platform presence for IMDA and senior management in terms of content calendaring and content development
  • Understand and have knowledge in marketing technology, be able to identify gaps in process and tech-stack to meet needs of IMDA across multiple channels
  • Understand data analysis and be able to draw out insights from data obtained through owned channels and integrate across other touchpoints and channels to deliver comms & marketing dashboard that will be able to drive decision-making
  • Lead engagement and counsel with Group Heads & Division HODs on developing effective communication across IMDA’s owned channels

Data management and use

  • Collect and track data to gauge effectiveness of our public communication efforts (whether strategic communication, line communication or brand management). Build tools and capability that empower IMDA lines as well as colleagues within CMD to leverage these data insights to refine their public communication approach.

Implementation and media relations

  • Oversee all aspects of media management work for IMDA-wide engagements, including preparation of media briefings, materials, media pitches and interview requests
  • Develop necessary corporate level collateral and assets in support of IMDA key events, which includes both external and internal facing events
  • Maintain and strengthen relations with local and foreign media and publications.

Team development

  • Lead and manage team members to further develop their capabilities and skillsets, continually improving standards of output from team
  • Put in place effective processes and tools (such as dashboards).
jobRequirements:
To thrive and be successful in this role, you must have / be:

  • A strategic and dynamic leader, with at least 12-15 years of relevant experience in communication, media and journalism
  • Government communications experience will be required, with at least 8 - 10 years in a supervisory role
  • Excellent media relations, written and spoken communication skills, with strong ability to nuance sensitive messaging and to make sound decisions
  • Ability to have an integrated view across all Lines/business units within IMDA in order to build an overarching strategic messaging platform
  • Adept at collaborating and managing multiple stakeholders internally and externally, as well as being able to prioritise work for team to ensure quality output is met
  • Experienced people manager with the interest to coach and develop staff
  • Strong team player who can work collaboratively within and across teams
  • Strong understanding and interest in technology, prior experience in ICT sectors is a plus

Position will be commensurate with experience.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

agencyDescription: MAS is the central bank of Singapore. Our mission is to promote sustained non-inflationary economic growth, and a sound and progressive financial centre.
jobDescription:
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is seeking a skilled Software Engineer to join our Gen AI team and develop next-generation applications powered by advanced AI technologies. This role focuses on hands-on implementation of AI-driven applications using cutting-edge AI frameworks that support MAS’ role in the Singapore's financial sector, whilst ensuring robust governance and operational excellence.

As a Software Engineer, you will implement and build production-grade web applications that leverage large language models and agentic AI systems. You will work with modern AI frameworks to develop user-facing applications that enhance productivity for AI developers, data scientists, and end users across MAS.
jobResponsibilities:
Agentic Web Application Development

Implement robust, scalable applications that enable autonomous AI agents using AI Frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) for complex multi-step reasoning and decision-making workflows. Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces that allow users to interact with, monitor, and control AI agents performing complex tasks and workflows.

Search & Retrieval Development

Implement web services and APIs that enable efficient search and retrieval of information from large-scale data repositories (e.g. Elastic / Redis) using hybrid search capabilities. Build data ingestion pipelines and vector indexing workflows that support real-time query processing and document retrieval. Develop robust error handling and fallback mechanisms for search service integration, including query reformulation and result ranking optimisation.

User Interface & Experience Implementation
Build intuitive web interfaces that enable MAS officers to interact with complex AI systems with lower learning curve. Implement dashboards, configuration panels, and monitoring interfaces that provide clear visibility into AI application performance and behaviour.

Performance Optimisation & Scalability
Implement performance optimisations for web applications handling AI workloads. Build caching mechanisms, request queuing systems, and load balancing solutions that ensure responsive user experiences even under heavy AI processing loads.

Security & Compliance Implementation
Implement security measures including authentication, authorisation, and data protection within web applications. Ensure all developments adhere to MAS operational controls and regulatory standards through proper implementation of security features and audit logging.
jobRequirements:
• Minimum 3-5 years experience as a full stack developer, with proven track record in the production of enterprise-grade applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security.

  • Strong proficiency in Python web frameworks (FastAPI, Django) and JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js, or Angular) and responsive web design

  • Hands-on experience with RESTful API development and integration

  • Knowledge of database integration (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and ORM frameworks

AI Framework Implementation

  • Practical experience with AI Frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) for building AI agent workflows and state management

  • Hands-on experience with self-hosted inference services vLLM for LLM interactions and parsing

  • Practical knowledge of LLM API integration and prompt engineering

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

This is a 1-year contract position. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

jobResponsibilities:

a)	Managing your own cases relating to the enforcement of maintenance orders. You will conduct (1) fact-finding and (2) conciliation, and (3) write reports regarding your findings. In conciliation, which replaces the existing mediation process, MEOs will play a more active role in seeking information and recommending solutions to the parties. You will be required to understand agreements reached between parties and draft the corresponding Consent Order. You will also need to appear in court via video-conferencing to assist parties in recording the Consent Order. You may also be required to appear in court if the judge requires your attendance to address any queries regarding the report. 

b)	Beyond your casework, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to projects relating to, amongst others, enhancing operational workflows, developing IT systems and testing GenAI products, and evaluating the maintenance enforcement process.

a)	[Strong interpersonal and communication skills] Strong communication abilities and emotional resilience to manage hostile or emotional situations, de-escalate conflicts, and facilitate constructive dialogue between parties with fundamental disagreements, particularly drawing from family law work, social work or counselling experience.
b)	[Investigating and Gathering Evidence] Ensure all evidence related to the case are appropriately obtained, documented, processed, and stored in accordance with agency policy and procedures to support case resolution. Able to assess financial information and formulate practical settlement proposals based on parties’ financial circumstances and needs (including understanding of common financial documents such as bank, CPF, and IRAS statements as well as payslips)
c)	[Case management] Independently manage multiple case files progression, as well as related financial matters while ensuring compliance with SOP and timelines.    
d)	[Leveraging on technology] Keep up to date on technological trends relevant to my work in enforcement, and adopt relevant technology-enabled solutions to address current and future enforcement challenges.
e)	[Application of law] Demonstrate understanding of and apply the fundamental legal principles, laws, legislation and government regulation to the relevant areas of work.

jobDescription:
The Singapore Public Service offers an attractive career proposition for those who seek to make a difference in service of Singapore and Singaporeans. 

To navigate a more complex and fast-changing environment, the Public Service needs a diversity of strengths and perspectives in our leadership ranks. We therefore welcome leaders with different backgrounds, who wish to contribute their skills and perspectives in the Public Service to make a meaningful impact to Singapore and Singaporeans.

If you take up a public service leadership career, we will invest in your development so that you can lead effectively in the Public Service, for today and tomorrow. A key feature of pursuing a public service leadership career is the opportunity for you to undergo structured job postings across different public agencies, to expose you to critical job experiences and key issues facing Government.
jobResponsibilities:
Here are some areas you could contribute to, across the key sectors of Government:

• Social: Shape the ‘heartware’ of Singapore – cultivating a more cohesive, resilient, caring and inclusive society.

• Economy Building: Contribute to Singapore’s growth, macro-economic stability, industry regulation and a conducive business environment.

• Infrastructure & Environment: Contribute to making Singapore a vibrant, clean, liveable city with sustainable development, robust infrastructure and good connectivity.

• Security: Keep Singapore safe and secure through robust enforcement capabilities and sound security policies.

• Central Administration: Ensure effective and efficient use of resources and help develop a consultative and customer-centric Public Service.

• Info-Comm Technology & Smart Systems: Enable better use of data and harnessing of new technologies by the Government to build a digital economy and digital society, in support of Smart Nation.
jobRequirements:
An ideal candidate will be one who: 

• Believes in and demonstrates the Public Service Values of Integrity, Service, Excellence.
• Has the passion to serve and a commitment towards building a better Singapore and to improve the lives of current and future generations of Singaporeans.
• Demonstrates strong leadership qualities, interpersonal skills and cognitive thinking capacities. More senior candidates should have a strong track record in demonstrating these key areas through past work experiences.
• Is a Singapore Citizen.

For new graduates, or individuals with around 1 year of working experience, you can look forward to a structured development programme on the PSLP General Phase (GP) that will expose you to the key job roles in the Public Service (i.e. across roles in policy, operations, stakeholder management). You will also get to experience work in at least 2 sectors to support you in understanding your longer-term career preferences and aspirations.

The Public Service values the experiences of mid-career entrants outside of the Public Service and is interested to groom talents with the heart to serve. • Central gateway for mid-career entrants to apply for Leadership Programmes in the Public Service
- Candidates may be considered for the PSLP Sectoral Phase (SP) or the Administrative Service (AS), where they would be supported in deepening their competencies either within a sector (PSLP SP) or across 2-3 sectors (AS).

The Singapore Department of Statistics is the National Statistical Authority responsible for statistics on the Singapore economy and population.

We collect, compile, analyse and disseminate a wide range of economic, business, household and population data, as well as analyse and monitor trends in the economy and population.

With these vital inputs, policymakers, business decision makers and our data users gain valuable insights into current and emerging economic and social trends, enabling them to make calculated and informed decisions in the formulation of policies and strategies for the future. Apart from public agencies and businesses, our users also include researchers, analysts, educators, students, the media and the general public.

jobDescription:
The Digital Transformation Office (DTO) is a strategic division within the corporate group dedicated to driving and overseeing digital transformation initiatives across IMDA. The DTO plays a pivotal role in developing and implementing comprehensive strategies that align with IMDA’s goals and objectives through the innovative use of emerging technology and data. By spearheading digital transformation initiatives, the DTO aims to revolutionize processes, elevate customer experiences, and foster a culture of innovation. Through collaboration with various departments, the DTO ensures that digital initiatives are integrated seamlessly across the organization, positioning IMDA to be at the forefront in the digital age.

Role Overview
The Head of Generative AI and Innovation will lead the strategic development and implementation of frontier Generative AI solutions across the organization. This role involves overseeing Generative AI team, forging innovation and driving the integration of generative AI technologies into products, processes, and services.

Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and drive the organization’s vision and strategy for generative AI, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and business value creation through AI-driven insights and solutions.
  • Develop and maintain a roadmap for AI adoption, piloting initiatives, and driving adoption across various business units.

2. Solution Development & Implementation

  • Lead cross-functional teams of data scientists, engineers, product managers, and domain experts to design, build, and deploy generative AI-driven solutions that address key business challenges.
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise-wide Generative AI platform, ensuring it is scalable, secure, compliant, and easily accessible to different business units.
  • Oversee large-scale AI projects, ensuring technical feasibility, budget management, and timely delivery.
  • Guide the development of proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and MVPs, creating scalable AI solutions that can be integrated into the organization’s technology stack.

3. Team Building & Management

  • Attract, hire, and retain top AI talent, developing an environment that fosters creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Coach and mentor team members, providing professional development opportunities and skill-building initiatives.
  • Establish agile project management practices, promoting high efficiency, accountability, and transparency.

4. Stakeholder Engagement

  • Collaborate with senior leadership, department heads, and external partners to identify business needs and evaluate AI solution viability.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts in clear, business-oriented language to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Build and maintain relationships with technology vendors, business lines and other external parties for potential partnerships and co-innovation projects.

5. Governance & Ethics

  • Define and implement best practices for AI ethics, data privacy, and responsible AI governance.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and internal policies.
  • Establish standards and guidelines for model deployment, monitoring, and risk management.

6. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop KPIs and metrics to measure the success, impact, and ROI of AI initiatives.
  • Implement processes for ongoing evaluation and optimization of AI models and processes.
  • Cultivate a data-driven culture and champion continuous improvement across all AI-related activities.

Requirements

  • Education
    • Background in computer science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field preferred. Equivalent experience in AI leadership and innovation may be considered.
  • Experience
    • 10+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or a similar field, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
    • Proven track record of delivering AI solutions (particularly generative models) in complex, high-impact environments.
    • Experience managing cross-functional teams and large-scale, transformational projects.
  • Technical Expertise
    • Proficiency in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and other AI domains.
    • Familiarity with the latest generative AI architectures (e.g., Transformer-based models, diffusion models, etc.) and large-language-model frameworks.
    • Experience with cloud-based AI platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and relevant ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.).
    • Demonstrated experience in building or integrating AI platforms in an enterprise setting.
  • Business Acumen
    • Strong understanding of how AI can drive business value, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to strategic objectives.
    • Experience in budgeting, project planning, and managing vendor relationships.
    • Adept at quantifying business impact and ROI of AI initiatives.
  • Leadership & Soft Skills
    • Exceptional communication skills, capable of translating complex technical topics into business language.
    • Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and mentor high-performing teams.
    • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities with a track record of managing ambiguity.
    • Collaborative mindset, capable of building consensus among diverse stakeholders.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to set a clear vision for AI initiatives that align with overall business goals.
  • Innovation & Creativity: Comfortable exploring novel approaches and challenging the status quo.
  • Execution Excellence: Track record of taking AI concepts to production, with a focus on quality and scalability.
  • Change Management: Skilled in driving organizational change, influencing culture shifts, and instilling a data-driven mindset.
  • Risk Management: Adept at identifying and mitigating technical, ethical, and compliance-related risks.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to forge partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.

jobDescription:
You will be part of the Attack Simulation Group (ASG) within the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA), a specialist team responsible for delivering advanced security testing and adversary-led assessments to strengthen the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). This is a senior, hands-on role for experienced offensive security practitioners who want to apply real-world attack techniques to complex, high-impact systems in support of Singapore’s national cyber security mission.

The Team
ASG is a technically driven team within CSA focused on realistic attack simulation, penetration testing, red teaming, and purple-teaming outcomes. Our work goes beyond compliance-driven assurance, emphasising hands-on testing, attacker tradecraft, and practical security improvements.

Operating within the realities of government, we value curiosity, adaptability, and out-of-the-box thinking. Specialised training and development opportunities are provided to continuously deepen and expand our technical capabilities, and team members are expected to continuously learn, apply skills across domains, and contribute to the evolution of attack simulation practices across Singapore’s CII.

We also believe in sharing and growing our craft where appropriate. Some of our public work and tooling can be found at:
👉 https://github.com/hack-techv2/
jobResponsibilities:
Responsibilities
•	Lead and conduct penetration testing, red teaming, and adversary simulation activities across web, mobile, infrastructure, cloud, OT, and telecommunications environments.
•	Execute realistic attack scenarios to assess the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII), including systems supporting essential services.
•	Support purple-teaming activities by translating offensive techniques into actionable detection and response improvements.
•	Lead engagements end-to-end, including planning, execution, reporting, and technical debriefs with stakeholders.
•	Mentor junior consultants and contribute to raising the team’s overall technical standard.
•	Drive continuous improvement of ASG’s testing methodologies, tooling, and research, including taking on problem spaces outside your primary domain when required.
•	And because this is government, be prepared to occasionally switch gears by contributing to strategic initiatives, supporting and executing procurement activities, participating in industry outreach, or undertaking coordination work, all of which ultimately help us strengthen security outcomes and make Singapore a safer place to live and work.

Why Join ASG at CSA
•	Work on nationally significant systems, including CII, OT, and telecommunications environments rarely accessible outside government.
•	Engage in deep, technically challenging work that prioritises realism, learning, and security outcomes over high-volume testing.
•	Apply your offensive security expertise to a public mission that directly contributes to Singapore’s cyber resilience.
•	Be part of a specialist team that is deliberately building towards strong technical depth, continuous learning, and moving beyond compliance-driven assurance, and help shape what “good” looks like along the way.
jobRequirements:
Requirements
•	An attacker’s mindset with strong technical understanding of operating systems, networks, and modern enterprise environments.

•	Proven ability to identify and execute real-world attack scenarios, beyond automated or checklist-based testing.
•	Experience in penetration testing and/or red team operations, with exposure to adversary tradecraft and attack chaining.
•	Demonstrated adaptability to transfer skills across technical domains (e.g. web to mobile, IT to OT, on-prem to cloud).
•	Strong technical writing skills and the ability to clearly articulate security risks and impact.
•	Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in penetration testing, red team operations, or related offensive security roles, with demonstrated depth in hands-on technical work.
•	Relevant industry certifications such as OSCP, CREST (e.g. CRT, CCT), CRTO, or equivalent are desirable. 
That said, we recognise that certifications alone do not define capability. Hands-on experience, problem-solving ability, and technical depth matter more to us than badges.

agencyDescription:
About the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore 
Established in 2015, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) seeks to keep Singapore’s cyberspace safe and secure to underpin our Nation Security, power a Digital Economy and protect our Digital Way of Life. It maintains an oversight of national cybersecurity functions and works with sector leads to protect Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure. CSA also engages with various stakeholders to heighten cyber security awareness, build a vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem supported by a robust workforce, pursue international partnerships and drive regional cybersecurity capacity building programmes. CSA is part of the Prime Minister’s Office and is managed by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information. For more news and information, please visit www.csa.gov.sg
jobDescription:
The successful candidate will be assigned to work in one of the various pillars in the division such as “Government Central Systems Development (GCS-Dev)”, “Government” and “Healthcare”. 

Lead a team of assistant directors, senior consultants, consultants and system engineers to provide cybersecurity consultancy through evaluating the risk assessment, security design review and plan and review security testing of GCS-Dev / Government/ Healthcare so as to ensure that the Systems are well protected while System owner accepts justifiable risk levels.
jobResponsibilities:
Perform the risk assessment for GCS-Dev/ Government/ Healthcare to ensure it is well protected and justify the risks to the System owner for risk acceptance
•	Collaborate with system owners and project team to understand the business and system requirements so that you can analyse and identify the cyber and physical threats and formulate the relevant project-specific scenarios and potential risks.
•	Propose people, process and technology (PPT) cybersecurity mitigation controls on the completed TRA Template and project-specific scenarios.
•	Justify the residual risks level for acceptance and approval by the designated approving authority.

Review the security design of GCS-Dev/ Government/ Healthcare ICT systems to identify areas of weaknesses and recommend security solution or controls to mitigate against highlighted threats.
•	Identify, assess and review cybersecurity solutions to secure ICT networks and systems.
•	Collaborate with system owners and project team to review and provide advice on the final proposed security design and mitigation controls.
•	Collaborate with system owners and project team to identify additional risks due to deviations in the final proposed security design and propose mitigation controls

Review security testing scopes and plans that validate and verify the security design of the GCS (Dev) / Government/ Healthcare ICT Systems.
•	Review vendor’s system security testing proposals and Penetration Test (PT) plans, and if needed, insert or counter propose test plans and test cases to make sure the security testing is comprehensive.
•	Review and provide advice to system owners and project team on the conduct of system security testing and PT.
•	Serves as controller to verify the execution of the system security testing and PT.
•	Assess and provide advice, identify risks and propose remediation measures on the findings and recommendations from the system security testing and PT reports

Optimise cybersecurity consultancy practices for effectiveness and efficiency of GCS-Dev/ Government/ Healthcare systems
•	Develop security reference architectures and threat reference models to optimise consultancy effectiveness and efficiencies.
•	Work with team members to develop, operate and publish the security reference architectures and threat reference models.
•	Enforce approved security reference architecture and threat reference models during cybersecurity consultancy.
•	Analyse lessons learned from consultancy works and incorporate areas of improvement to enhance Consultancy Models, security reference architecture and threat reference models

Manage Team Capability Development
•	Managed Team esprit de corps, professional and personal developments
•	Develop training plans for the team based on competency framework i.e. RTEC (Raise + Train + Evaluate = Capability) Framework.
•	Identify suitable training programmes/events/seminars for each team role to associate the required capability in dealing with ever-changing cybersecurity threats landscape.
•	Monitor training budget allocated and provide updates to management when required.
•	Establish processes for Knowledge Management for purpose of cybersecurity consultancy knowledge sharing and retentions
jobRequirements:
•	Bachelor Degree in Information Communication Technology-related discipline
(Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems), Science or Engineering etc.
•	Professional qualifications such as CISSP, SANS, CISA, CRISC or equivalent
•	At least 15 to 20 years relevant working experience and more than 10 years of supervisory experience to manage, work and collaborate with various parties including stakeholders, system owners, teammates and contractors
•	Good understanding and interest in Cybersecurity 
•	Technically hands-on and curious about inner workings of technology
•	Strong analytical and conceptualisation skills
•	Good communications and interpersonal relationship skills, stakeholder management 
•	Driven and capable to work independently. Resourceful, responsible, motivated and able to work independently as well as in a team.

If you share our passion to make a difference in the cyber security landscape, take up the challenge and apply now.

All applicants will be notified of whether they are shortlisted or not within four weeks of the closing date of this job posting. 

For any issues with the application, you may drop your resume with us at csa_recruit@csa.gov.sg.

jobResponsibilities:
The Active Health Coach works closely with the Team Lead and stakeholders to implement, monitor, and evaluate SportSG Frailty Prevention Programmes and other initiatives. This role helps seniors stay fit, active, and socially engaged while improving their health and well-being, in alignment with Active Health/SportSG's vision to transform lives through sport. The Active Health Coach also ensures smooth operations of Active Health labs, including fitness and health assessments, workshops, exercise testing, and wellness coaching, supporting citizens on their health journey both physically and digitally.

Role and Responsibilities

•	To review literature and synthesize evidence to create holistic health and wellness programmes, along with training curricula for instructor-led sessions.
•	To collaborate with the Planning & Partnership team and Taskforce members to develop digital resources and segment-based content.
•	To deliver out-of-lab programmes, like CALM 1.0 Week 1 Orientation and Week 8 Check-In, for seniors.
•	To conduct group health and wellness coaching sessions for seniors.
•	To train instructors to deliver programmes like CALM 1.0, Aqua Fun Fit, and Square Stepping, ensuring programme quality.
•	To collaborate with ActiveSG and community partners, including Active Ageing Centres (AACs), to implement Active Health programmes.
•	To collect and analyze data for programme evaluation and reporting.
•	To conduct group workshops on movement and non-movement tools to support seniors in maintaining well-being in their daily lives.
•	To provide individual and group health and wellness coaching services tailored to seniors.
•	To offer online health and wellness coaching support for seniors to enhance their overall health and engagement.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for self-motivated individuals who value integrity, teamwork and take pride in going the extra mile to provide excellent service to stakeholders and the community. 

This individual should be a sport advocate through living an active lifestyle and staying active.

In addition, an ideal candidate should possess the following:

•	Specialisation in Sport Nutrition, Psychology or Physiotherapy would be an advantage
•	At least 3 years of proven experience and/or track record in content development for exercise, health and wellness programmes
•	Experience in operations work with fitness and health/healthcare industry
•	Excellent communication skills
•	Possess the aptitude and attitude to engage with the general public and serve the citizens
•	Willing to take up the challenge to establish norms and best practices for the lab operations and content development
•	Adaptable to fast-moving pace of services and strategies for the lab
•	Open to potential changing nature of work scope, enthusiastic and willing to learn on the job
•	Possess a keen eye for details
•	Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and service improvement
•	Self-motivated and takes initiative to perform tasks

jobResponsibilities:
- Oversee the various line of efforts with the multifaceted teams, including the research, product management, data science, to curate and chart AI strategies for the respective Centres of Excellence (COEs)
- Operationalise AI by working with stakeholders to get the necessary cross-flow of knowledge, codes and talents, driving technical discussions with the COEs to ensure that their AI developments are aligned to the overall strategy, as well as providing technical guidance for the building of AI solutioning and validation of models
- Lead technical discussions and present complex AI solutioning to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Oversee the knowledge management efforts of codes and algorithm so as to enable code reusability and efficiently

As part of the Transformation Division in SIR, you will be involved in a cross-functional team to drive MSF’s data strategy, formulate data governance policies/processes and build data capabilities within MSF. 

Reporting to the Senior Assistant Director (Data Governance Office) of the Transformation Division within SIR, you will be part of a high-performing team of officers who are committed to drive data transformation within MSF and the social service sector.

Join us in shaping MSF's data transformation journey. We are seeking a skilled professional to help implement MSF's Data Plan and enhance our data management capabilities.

•	Undertake data integration initiatives by working closely with MSF Divisions and other government agencies to incorporate their datasets into our centralised data analytics platform
•	Maintain and update data governance frameworks within the analytics Platform to ensure compliance with IM8 policy requirements
•	Establish and monitor data quality standards, ensuring all datasets meet required quality thresholds
•	Serve as the enterprise data steward for the analytics platform, overseeing data management practices and maintaining data integrity across the platform
•	Support data requests to external agencies and data platforms within Singapore’s Public Service

•	Knowledge of data integration processes (e.g knowledge of APIs) and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) concepts
•	Familiarity with data analytics platforms (e.g DataBricks) and data management tools

•	Basic SQL knowledge and data manipulation skills (e.g. CRUD operations, Table Joins, Group By and subqueries)
•	Ability to document processes and maintain documentation (preferably some knowledge of Confluence and Jira) 
•	Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
•	Collaborative mindset and team player attitude

agencyDescription:
The Ministry of Health’s (MOH) vision is to champion a healthy nation with our people – to live well, live long and with peace of mind. As an open country constantly exposed to an interconnected world, Singapore faces complex issues in public healthcare. MOH constantly grapples with new challenges brought on by an increasingly globalised world, a rapidly ageing population and rising expectations. MOH’s responses to these challenges include preventing and managing the outbreak of diseases such as SARS and Influenza A (H1N1), designing a healthcare system that delivers care in an integrated and effective manner, growing the capacity and capabilities within the sector, and managing healthcare inflation.

As an MOH officer, you will be involved in formulating and implementing policies that guide Singapore’s healthcare ecosystem. You will work alongside a team with varied skills and backgrounds, but with the common goals of (i) promoting good health and reducing illnesses; (ii) ensuring that Singaporeans have access to good and affordable healthcare; and (iii) pursuing medical excellence. Your work will have far-reaching impact on the health and lives of Singaporeans.

These include national-level health data systems such as the National Electronic Health Record (NEHR), public-facing national digital health platforms such as HealthHub, and other streamlined systems for healthcare providers including web portals.

•	Develop and review policies to ensure alignment with the changing landscape, business needs and user expectations
•	Drive planning and operational aspects to ensure successful implementation and ongoing management of projects 
•	Craft strategies to promote adoption of diverse healthcare IT initiatives and bolster governance through various levers (e.g. legislative, financial).
•	Provide staffing and secretariat support for key forums where healthcare strategies and plans are discussed

•	At least three (3) years of experience in policy development and implementation and/or roll-out of major IT projects
•	Interest in digital health trends, opportunities and challenges
•	Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to synthesise perspectives and considerations and develop cogent proposals
•	Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with stakeholders within the healthcare sector and across public service to understand priorities and business demands
•	Results-oriented with a track record of delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment
•	Resourceful and comfortable navigating ambiguity and change

•	Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities to support the crafting of sound policy recommendations; ability to grasp timelines, operating context and ground realities.
•	Drive and curiosity to learn and apply new skills, knowledge and new ways of working.

jobDescription:
[What the role is]

You will be part of the Strategic Planning (SP) team within IMDA’s Strategic Planning and Digital Readiness Group. The SP team develops the overall strategy and plan for the Digital Economy blueprint, which guides IMDA’s work in developing and implementing the infrastructure, policy, governance and sectoral plans for digitalisation across sectors in Singapore.

This includes engaging and collaborating with various IMDA divisions, other government agencies, and industry players, to understand and analyse technology and industry developments, identify opportunities and incubate ideas, assess policy and governance issues relating to the digital economy, and develop strategies and plans. We would like to invite an independent and self-motivated individual with keen interest in contributing to the growth of Singapore’s digital economy.

[What you will be working on]

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research, sense making and forecasting of trends relevant to the infocomm and media landscape by synthesising research and data from multiple sources. This includes identifying and evaluating technology, market and regulatory trends and opportunities for Singapore.

  • Work with internal divisions and relevant government/public agencies on matters relating to digital economy, technology trends and developments, including carrying out economic, statistical and/or policy assessments to facilitate evidence-based policy and strategy formulation and decision-making.

  • Develop mid to long-term goals and strategic objectives for IMDA and the economy digitalisation plans and facilitate the planning process to translate strategies into actionable workplans.

  • Carry out studies and collaborations with key partners (e.g. other government agencies, think tanks, research institutions and academia) on the development of economic analysis, think pieces and research publications.

  • Develop/refine our digital economy strategies and plans, as well as develop international thought leadership in these areas.

  • Collaborate with internal divisions, or lead cross-division projects, and with relevant government/public agencies on matters relating to digital economy, technology trends and developments, including carrying out strategic reviews and assessments to develop mid to long-term goals and strategic objectives for IMDA and the Digital Economy.

  • Manage and coordinate strategic resources, corporate initiatives, processes and operational plans, including with other Ministries or government agencies, to ensure alignment with overall strategies.

  • Lead cross-division reviews/analysis of greenfield opportunities and ideas for Digital Economy, including development of strategies, plans and programmes in these new areas.

Requirements

  • You should have a good understanding of the Infocomm and Media sectors, Economic landscape and Public Policy/Administration, with, minimally, 5 years of experience in relevant fields or capacity.

  • You should possess strong analytical skills with economic/statistical background, and understand data and ICT trends, and be comfortable navigating uncertainties at the intersection of technology, policy and regulation.

  • You should enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, including tight deadlines, and be able to work independently as well as in a team/cross-team setting.

  • You should have excellent writing and communication skills, with ability to prepare analysis, assessments and presentations in a clear and concise manner, using tools such as word, excel and powerpoint.

evaluated, well-coordinated, and safely executed in a live environment that the entire nation depends on.
